format: bit 5 -- adaptive k per keyword

format: bit 8 -- onion tunnels active

format: bit 9 -- sealed channels (Ed25519+HKDF)

format: bit 10 -- channel gossip

format: bit 11 -- Poisson cover cells

format: bit 12 -- multi-cell tunnel data plane

format: bit 13 -- Live segment fragmentation (SHIPPED+validated)

name: ESE_CAP_TUNNEL_BULK
format: bit 14 -- high-throughput tunnel bulk data plane

name: ESE_CAP_HOLEPUNCH_RDV
format: bit 15 -- opt-in 3-way rendezvous; runtime advertisement requires both hole-punch and EseKad3Rendezvous kill switches

name: ESE_CAP_KAD_KEEPALIVE
format: bit 16 -- nonce-correlated Kad keepalive; advertised only while explicit NetLab participation and the local R.2 service are enabled, and used only with connected peers that also advertise active NetLab participation

name: ESE_CAP_REACH_V2
format: bit 17 -- strict TAG_ESE_REACH v2 codec and route projection; advertised after host integration

name: ESE_CAP_TUNNEL_AUTH
format: bit 18 -- authenticated tunnel handshake (CREATE/CREATED v2, Ed25519 signed). Advertised only while the persistent node identity is available; authenticates the exit capability snapshot used by Kad6.

name: ESE_CAP_HOLEPUNCH_COOKIE
format: bit 19 -- return-routability cookie for eSE hole-punch (anti-reflection). Cookie flow wired (Process_ESE_HOLEPUNCH_REQ/CHALLENGE + EseHolePunchCookie). LOAD-BEARING: gates stateless challenge for unverified entries; informational otherwise. Two-tier gate in Process_ESE_HOLEPUNCH_REQ: TIER1 verified-known contact (IsIpVerified) -> legacy ACK+seed; TIER2 gray zone (unknown OR known-but-unverified) -> challenge IFF sender advertises this bit, else floored ACK+seed (back-compat for legacy peers). Slot below 15/16/17/18 = RDV/KEEPALIVE/REACH_V2/AUTH.

name: ESE_CAP_LIVE_RELAY
format: bit 21 -- R.3 buddy relay egress (broadcaster connect-out + 0xCF SETUP/CHUNK + 0xCE downstream re-emit). Advertised iff GetEseRelayAccept() (default OFF); a node that does not accept relay duty keeps its caps byte-identical. Egress bandwidth bounded by pref EseRelayMaxKBps. bit 20 deliberately skipped (LIVE_BLAKE3).

name: ESE_CAP_KAD6
format: bit 24 -- canonical Kad6 discovery gateway. Advertised only with a persistent node identity and non-Direct privacy mode; originators require the authenticated exit snapshot before sending K6Frame. Fine-grained K6_CAP_* remain in the signed u64.

name: ESE_CAP_TUNNEL_STRICT3
format: bit 25 -- authenticated CREATE/EXTEND v3 and iterative three-hop forwarding for Kad6 STRICT. Every selected hop must advertise it; absence fails the STRICT request closed. Direct, one-hop quota-issuer and two-hop Private profiles remain separate protocols and are never a STRICT downgrade.

name: ESE_CAP_TUNNEL_SHAPED
format: bit 26 -- Kad6 class-5 fixed 17000-byte bulk carrier, independent per-link scheduler, bounded 2-5 second reservoir and regenerated padding. STRICT requires it on all three signed hops; no silent unshaped downgrade.

name: ESE_CAP_KAD6_ECONOMY
format: bit 27 -- K6-8 RFC 9474 RSABSSA anonymous quota wire plus measured rho admission. Advertises protocol support only; runtime deployment policy remains separate.

name: ESE_CAP_NETLAB_V1
format: bit 28 -- explicit participation in the bounded public beta network-lab cohort. Presence means consent is active now; build support or beta installation alone never sets it. Peers without the bit, including v8.1 and vanilla, are excluded from automatic cohort attempts.

name: CAP_FORK_IPV6_WIRE
format: bit 0 -- peer speaks _V6 opcodes

name: CAP_FORK_IPV6_KAD
format: bit 1 -- historically named native Kad6 capability; runtime advertisement requires a persistent identity and at least one signed public IPv4 or IPv6 UDP endpoint under the family-neutral OP_KAD6HEADER plane

name: CAP_FORK_IPV6_DUALSTACK
format: bit 2 -- peer has both v4 + v6 reachable

name: CAP_FORK_ED25519
format: bit 3 -- peer speaks signed live chunks
